segments.sn34.41-45:1.1: 702-706. Sāvatthinidānaṃ …“samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo … samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo hoti, na samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo … neva samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo hoti, na ca samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo … samādhismiṃ ārammaṇakusalo ca hoti, samādhismiṃ gocarakusalo ca.
segments.sn34.41-45:1.6: Tatra, bhikkhave, yvāyaṃ jhāyī … pe … uttamo ca pavaro cā”ti.
segments.sn34.41-45:1.8: Ekacattālīsamaṃ.(Purimamūlakāni viya yāva pañcacattālīsamā ārammaṇamūlakasappāyakārīsuttā pañca suttāni pūretabbāni. Ārammaṇamūlakaṃ.)
